voxymap.ui.title: Voxy Map
voxymap.ui.hint: %s close   Scroll zoom   Drag pan   Middle-click/drag into 3D   %s center on player   Right-click menu
voxymap.ui.hint3d: %s close   Scroll zoom   Drag pan   Middle-drag rotate   Middle-click back to 2D   %s center on player   Right-click menu
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainNearDistan: Distance that uses the highest mesh precision (default 512).
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainMidDistanc: Distance that uses the medium mesh precision (default 2048).
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainNearStep: Map pixels per vertex for near tiles; 1 is the highest precision.
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainMidStep: Map pixels per vertex for mid-distance tiles.
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainFarStep: Map pixels per vertex for far tiles; used to fill the map quickly.
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainSkirtDepth: Vertical skirt depth at tile borders to hide precision seams.
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTerrainHysteresis: Hysteresis percentage for precision changes; avoids rebuild churn.
voxymap.config.desc.gpu3dBatchBuild: Maximum tile builds submitted per frame.
voxymap.config.desc.keep3dTilesIn2d: Keep GPU tiles after returning to 2D for faster re-entry, at the cost of VRAM.
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.title: LOD data may not be ready yet
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.message: It is recommended to wait for LOD generation before refreshing the map. Refresh now?
voxymap.ui.overworldOnly: Only overworld LOD maps are supported for now
voxymap.config.desc.mapScale: Blocks represented by one map pixel.
voxymap.config.desc.maxLodLevel: Highest-detail level read from Voxy data.
voxymap.config.desc.cacheKeepCount: Number of map caches to keep; the oldest are removed beyond this.
voxymap.config.desc.autoSeaLevel: Take the sea level from the world automatically.
voxymap.config.desc.seaLevelOverride: Manual sea level, used when auto detection is off.
voxymap.config.desc.defaultStyle: Map style used for new worlds.
voxymap.config.desc.defaultZoom: Initial zoom when the map opens.
voxymap.config.desc.drawContours: Draw contour lines on the terrain.
voxymap.config.desc.minContourArea: Ignore contour fragments smaller than this.
voxymap.config.desc.drawHillshade: Shade terrain with a light direction to show relief.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeColors: Tint grass, leaves and water by biome in the block-color style.
voxymap.config.desc.adaptiveColorRamp: Stretch the ramp to this world's actual height range.
voxymap.config.desc.landMaxRamp: Use the map's highest point as the top of the land ramp.
voxymap.config.desc.waterBlurRadius: Sampling radius of the water blur.
voxymap.config.desc.fillHoles: Fill small holes inside the terrain.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelMinArea: Biomes smaller than this are not labelled.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelBackground: Add a background to biome labels for readability.
voxymap.config.desc.arrowStyle: Texture used for the 2D player marker.
voxymap.config.desc.showRenderDistance: Outline the render distance on the map.
voxymap.config.desc.releaseTexturesOnClo: Free map textures when the map closes to save VRAM.
voxymap.config.desc.skipWorldRender: Do not render the world behind the open map.
voxymap.config.desc.showCoordinates: Show the hovered position and biome.
voxymap.config.desc.showHint: Show the key hints at the top of the screen.
voxymap.config.desc.teleportEnabled: Teleport to the target from the right-click menu.
voxymap.config.desc.debugEnabled: Enable the debug panel (toggle with Q).
voxymap.config.desc.debugRefreshChat: Print a compact refresh report to the chat (mode, trigger, changed sections, dirty area, timings).
voxymap.config.desc.debugVoxyEvents: PoC: log Voxy's live section dirty callbacks (counts, levels, threads, sample copyData).
voxymap.config.desc.debugTileTrace: Write cache/source/color/texture/evict stages per tile to logs/voxymap-tile-*.log.
voxymap.config.desc.liveTiles: Experimental: update 2D map tiles directly from Voxy section change events.
voxymap.config.desc.tileResidentCap: Maximum resident tiles in memory; higher values reduce reloads but use more RAM.
voxymap.config.desc.gpuTextureBudgetMb: Estimated VRAM budget for tile textures; off-screen textures are released first while pixels/colour stay in RAM.
voxymap.config.desc.diskCacheMaxMb: Maximum .vxt disk cache; oldest files are removed first and resident tiles are never deleted by this cleanup.
voxymap.config.desc.rememberZoom: Restore the previous zoom per world.
voxymap.config.desc.verticalScale3d: Vertical stretch factor applied to terrain height.
voxymap.config.desc.fov3d: Vertical field of view of the perspective projection.
voxymap.config.desc.remember3dView: Reopen the map in the same 2D/3D mode.
voxymap.ui.oversize.title: Memory warning
voxymap.ui.oversize.line1: This map is about %s x 100M pixels, above the %s x 100M limit.
voxymap.ui.oversize.line2: Loading it may run out of memory and crash the game.
voxymap.ui.oversize.line3: The limit can be changed in config/voxymap-client.json (maxMapPixels).
voxymap.ui.oversize.noSafe: Even the coarsest 1:8 map would exceed the memory limit.
voxymap.ui.outOfMemory: Out of memory: this map is too large for the game's heap. Lower the map scale (1:3 or coarser) or raise the game memory.
voxymap.config.desc.playerMarkerHeight3d: How far above the terrain the player arrow floats.
voxymap.config.desc.playerMarkerScale3d: Arrow size multiplier; it also scales with camera distance.
voxymap.config.desc.autoHideContours3d: Hide contour lines while the 3D view is open.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabel3dRange: Only biome labels within this horizontal distance are shown in 3D.
